orders_source_event_root_unique.name: orders_source_event_root_unique

orders_client_order_ref_live_root_unique.name: orders_client_order_ref_live_root_unique
orders_client_order_ref_live_root_unique.where: client_order_ref is not null and status <> 'cancelled' and follow_on_of_order_id is null
